SELECT
  COALESCE(cg.geolocation_state, c.customer_state) AS customer_state,
  COALESCE(sg.geolocation_state, s.seller_state) AS seller_state,
  AVG(ABS((CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE))::INT))::NUMERIC(10,2) AS average_delivery_delay_days,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi
  ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN sellers s
  ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
JOIN customers c
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN geolocation cg
  ON c.customer_zip_code_prefix = cg.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
LEFT JOIN geolocation sg
  ON s.seller_zip_code_prefix = sg.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY COALESCE(cg.geolocation_state, c.customer_state), COALESCE(sg.geolocation_state, s.seller_state)
ORDER BY average_delivery_delay_days DESC
LIMIT 30;
